title: Chicken Casserole
description: A simple and delicious casserole made with chicken, vegetables, and cheese. This dish is perfect for a weeknight dinner or a weekend meal.
instructions: Cut the French bread into 1-inch cubes and toast in the oven for 5 minutes.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium-high heat. Add the chicken and cook until browned and cooked through.
Add the diced potatoes to the skillet and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked chicken and potatoes, casserole, shredded cheese, salt, and pepper.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and top with additional shredded cheese.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Sprinkle with chopped parsley and serve hot.
